subject: HealthFlux - Questionnaire route & data residency check
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Knight <rachel.knight@healthflux.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: questionnaire preference + a couple clarifying items from today's call

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the time on the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned:

- HealthFlux is evaluating Redwood to power several internal search and summarization features for provider notes (POC scope we discussed).
- Primary compliance concerns: SOC 2 Type II evidence, HIPAA handling for PHI, and EU residency for certain datasets (you mentioned a subset of research data might be EU-resident).

Can you confirm which questionnaire format you prefer for kickoff? Options we can support: SIG/CAIQ (standard), SIG Lite (faster), or your custom form. If you prefer SIG/CAIQ we can prefill our answers and route to your security mailbox.

Two quick clarifying questions from our engineers/security team so we scope evidence correctly:
1) Will HealthFlux need on-prem or VPC deployment for the initial POC, or is hosted API acceptable for the evaluation?
2) For the data residency point — which product flows contain EU-resident data? (e.g., research dataset only, or also provider notes).

I've attached a short prefill template (redwood-sig-lite-prefill.xlsx) and a simplified dataflow diagram we sketched on the call.

Suggested next steps:
- You confirm preferred questionnaire type and primary evidence owner (security@healthflux.com is fine).
- We'll send a prefill and SOC 2 evidence bundle (if available) within 48 hours of confirmation.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on the preference so we can avoid back-and-forth.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-sig-lite-prefill.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12 KB)
Attachment: healthflux-initial-dataflow.png (image, 85 KB)

From: Rachel Knight <rachel.knight@healthflux.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@healthflux.com
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 08:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: questionnaire preference + a couple clarifying items from today's call

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the summary and for the attachments. Quick answers:

- Questionnaire: Security prefers SIG Lite to start (we're trying to move quickly). If you can prefill, that helps a lot.
- Evidence: Please send SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), architecture diagram, and encryption-at-rest/in-transit specifics. We will also need your data processing addendum (DPA) for review.
- Deployment: For the POC, hosted API is acceptable, provided we get commitments on data segregation and an EU region option for the research dataset.
- EU data: The research dataset only needs EU residency. Provider notes will be US-only for the POC.

Security asked for an expected turnaround: within 5 business days would be ideal. If you can provide a prefilled SIG Lite + SOC 2 report this week, we can open the internal review.

I'll loop in our security mailbox (cc'd). If you have a secure upload link (SharePoint or SFTP), please send it rather than email attachments.

Best,
Rachel Knight
Head of Security Programs, HealthFlux
rachel.knight@healthflux.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 08:28:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: HealthFlux preference — quick technical clarifications

Jasmine / Irene —

Forwarding Rachel's reply. A couple notes from engineering/security so we provide the right artifacts:

- We should prefill the SIG Lite and include a short notes tab that calls out
  - model hosting (hosted API, multi-tenant) and our KV/prefix cache behavior,
  - encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest with KMS-managed keys,
  - SOC 2: we have a recent Type II report (2026) and a summary of scope; need to confirm if HealthFlux wants the redacted full report or a vendor attestation.

- On EU residency: we can enable served-from-region routing to an EU region for the research dataset. We need to know whether HealthFlux requires data to be physically resident in EU (data-at-rest) or just processed in-region for residency compliance. That will change whether we need to stand up a dedicated deployment or can use hosted EU region.

- Timeline: if Rachel expects docs in 5 business days, we should aim to send the prefill + SOC 2 summary same day and a secure upload of the full report within 48 hours after (assuming approvals).

Irene — can you review the prefill and SOC2 summary before we upload? I noted two attachments already in Jasmine's email.

Thanks,
Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HealthFlux preference — SIG Lite route & uploads

Hi all —

Thanks Rachel for the confirmation. We'll proceed as follows:

1) Jasmine/Ben: I'll review and sign off on the SIG Lite prefill. Ben, please drop the prefill in the secure upload location once ready.
2) Jasmine: I'll prepare a redacted SOC 2 summary (2026 Type II) and a short note describing the scope and controls; then we'll provide the full report via SharePoint link after HealthFlux security confirms access.
3) Rachel: please confirm whether EU residency requirement is "data-at-rest" or "in-region processing". If it's data-at-rest we will evaluate the need for a dedicated EU deployment; if in-region processing is sufficient we can enable EU-region serving on hosted immediately.

Tentative timeline: prefill + SOC2 summary uploaded within 24–48 hours; full report via secure link once access is verified.

Jasmine — I'll copy the final upload link here.

Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
